root_cause.defect_1: lastUsedTokens only stopped at assistant steps lacking numeric usage; a tool-only response from a usage-omitting provider carries usage {stopReason} on its first tool_call, which was skipped, so an older response's count was returned.
root_cause.defect_2: streamOpenAIResponse added stream_options.include_usage unconditionally with no fallback when a strict provider rejects the field.

fix.defect_1: In lastUsedTokens a step carrying a usage object without numeric token counts is a response boundary and returns undefined (shared/context-usage.ts). UsageCarrier.usage gained optional stopReason (type only). Docstring: residual now only responses with no usage object at all.
fix.defect_2: server/openai-client.ts: module-level Set streamOptionsRejectedBy keyed by config.baseUrl; on a 4xx whose body matches /stream_options|include_usage/ the request is retried exactly once without stream_options and the base URL is remembered; later requests omit the field. Other errors unchanged (same thrown message).
fix.spec: specs/epic-compaction-tool/spec.md Design Decision 5/7 and dated Amendment 2026-10-03 (extended per round); acceptance-criteria.md Terminology 'fill' amended in round 1.
fix.remediation_1: src/lib/context-window.ts computeContextFill: zero fill (none-yet) only when the history has no model response (no assistant step, no tool_call step, no step with a usage object of any shape); otherwise unknown. lastUsedTokens untouched; stream- filter kept. tool_call steps are always model-produced (tool results are separate steps), so all three conditions were used. AC Terminology 'fill' amended; spec.md DD7 cross-reference and the 2026-10-03 Amendment extended.
fix.remediation_2: A: server/openai-client.ts and server/ollama-client.ts always attach a usage object (possibly {}) when the stream completes; interrupted streams throw/return earlier and stay without one. Checked consumers: transcript.ts only prints defined fields, token-view needs inputTokens, conversation-card uses ?? 0, normalizeResponseSteps/retainResponseUsage already handle usage-bearing empty responses (an empty completion now yields a collapsed 'Model usage' meta step). B: field-rejection check excludes 401/403/429; base URL remembered only after the retry returns ok.
fix.remediation_3: server/response-usage.ts: retainResponseUsage returns the (empty) steps unchanged when usage has no fields and there are no steps; responses with steps keep usage {} on the first step. server/openai-client.ts: rejectsStreamOptions reads the 4xx body via readBoundedBody (8 KiB, 2 s timeout, reader cancelled, read errors incl. abort -> not a rejection).

tests/integration/openai-client.test.ts: 4 tests in 'stream_options fallback for strict providers' (one retry + memory per base URL; include_usage/422; no retry for 401/400-unrelated/500; single retry cap)
tests/integration/completed-response-usage-boundary.test.ts (both providers: completed tool-only response without usage/finish reason -> usage {} and lastUsedTokens undefined)
tests/unit/context-window.test.ts: empty-usage tool_call after numeric response -> unknown
tests/integration/openai-client.test.ts: 401/403/429 no retry and not remembered; failed retry not remembered
tests/integration/openai-client.test.ts: stalled 4xx body fails promptly with original error (fake timers); empty successful stream -> no steps
